verdict.rationale: llamafile's own CLI documents a `--server` mode with HTTP server, API and Web UI options. The quickstart shows the server serving on localhost:8080 after the llamafile is run, and a community user praises the CLI and web server UX, so starting the server from the command line is supported. Stopping the server, or managing its lifecycle, is never documented. Missing for 10: documented stop/shutdown or background lifecycle commands, hands-on corroboration of starting and stopping the server.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start and stop the local model server from the command line

citations.quote: llamafile --server --help ... HTTP server, API, Web UI, slot, and server sandbox options.
just open a browser window and connect to http://localhost:8080/
llamafile is the model, runtime, and server in one file.
The llamafile UX (CLI interface and web server with chat) is great
